{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hyggin Mountains''' were located on the forest [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Seltos]], on the far side of the planet from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Sommin City]]. [[Galacticorp Mines]] were bidding for the rights to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the mountains during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Twin Stars">{{WEGCite|story=Freedom Strike Seltos (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
